gloss: to comb one's hair; to brush one's hair

definitions.gloss: to comb one's hair; to brush one's hair
definitions.explanation: To use a comb or brush to untangle and arrange one's hair. A common daily grooming action.

examples.english: To comb one's hair in front of the mirror.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、{髪|かみ}を{梳|と}かして⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: In the morning, I combed my hair before going out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やさしく{梳|と}かして⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: The mother gently combed her daughter's long hair.

notes:
USAGE:
{梳|と}かす specifically means to comb or brush through hair. It can also be written as {解|と}かす (using a different kanji that emphasizes untangling). The tool used can be either a ⟦{櫛|くし}→櫛：03882_kushi⟧ (comb) or a ⟦ブラシ→ブラシ：01503_burashi⟧ (brush).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{櫛|くし}→櫛：03882_kushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{髪|かみ}を{梳|と}かす (to comb one's hair with a comb)
- ⟦ブラシ→ブラシ：01503_burashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{髪|かみ}を{梳|と}かす (to brush one's hair)
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{髪|かみ}を{梳|と}かす (to carefully comb one's hair)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とく: to untangle hair — more focused on removing knots
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to arrange one's hair — broader term for tidying up one's hairstyle
